The '''First Patriarch''' was a religious leader on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Serroco]]. During the [[Mandalorian Wars]], and up until [[Gender/Legends|his]] [[Death/Legends|death]] during the [[Jedi Civil War]], [[Lelin-Dor]] held the position.
